title: Bushy bluestem and Indiangrass field-photo and comparison lessons
reason: Finished two existing canonical Poaceae species' crew training and updated both relevant genus lessons. Bushy bluestem gets corrected Hawaiian var. pumilus image roles, 2 public visual references, more robust crowded raceme/spathe identification. Indiangrass gets 'rifle-sight' ligule plus single panicle and fertile sessile spikelet / naked pedicel comparison, with 3 source-licensed external visual references. No anatomy arrows were added without full-resolution pixel verification.

remaining_gaps: Local bushy bluestem flowering whole specimen and identified paired spathe/raceme macro with mm scale
Indiangrass exact collar rifle-sight ligule macro with mm scale
Both mature attached spikelet units/awns and pixel-verified arrows
Independent matched S. nutans vs S. elliottii adult detail images
